# moddotplot-rs v0.7.0

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

v0.7.0 adds explicit Self, Pairwise, and Grid plot workflows for sessions containing
multiple FASTA records. The release remains a functional preview. Local source, build,
and supported-engine browser verification is complete; see the
[validation record](v0.7.0/VALIDATION.md). Git-derived packaging and tagging remain a
final repository-owner step because this checkpoint was prepared from a source archive.

## Plot modes

Mode tabs appear only after more than one record has been loaded. A single-record
session retains a compact self-plot interface with one sequence selector.

* **Self plot** uses one selector and compares the chosen sequence with itself.
* **Pairwise plot** retains the existing independent X and Y sequence selectors and
  interactive behavior.
* **Grid plot** accepts `n` from 2 through the smaller of 6 or the number of loaded
  records, then presents `n` selectors whose sequence choices must be distinct.

## Bounded grid overview

For `n` selected sequences, Grid mode calculates `n` self comparisons and
`n choose 2` unique pairwise comparisons. The work runs serially, and every comparison
is bounded to a quick 256 by 256 overview. At the six-sequence limit this is 21 unique
calculations: 6 self plots and 15 pairwise plots.

The main pane renders a complete symmetric `n`-by-`n` matrix. Self plots occupy the
diagonal. Each pairwise result is calculated once, placed in one off-diagonal cell,
and transposed into its mirror cell so the two axes remain consistent with the matrix
row and column labels.

Grid mode is an overview rather than a collection of simultaneous detailed viewports.
Feature tracks, Reset view, and current-view data/image export are unavailable while
it is active. Clicking a diagonal cell opens that sequence in the interactive Self
plot; clicking an off-diagonal cell opens the corresponding interactive Pairwise plot,
where the usual navigation, tracks, reset, and export controls apply.

Local validation passed the Rust, TypeScript, Wasm, optimized build, documentation,
dependency-inventory, and Chromium/Firefox/WebKit gates. The retained record gives the
